# Shadia AI. AI for Clinics

## What is Shadia AI?

Shadia AI is an AI platform for clinics and medical practices. It combines clinical session documentation, an AI receptionist, and a native appointments engine, so clinicians focus on care while Shadia runs front-desk and documentation workflows.

Languages: Spanish (default, focused on Dominican Republic and Latin America) and English (global).

Shadia AI is **not** a generic chatbot builder or multi-industry helpdesk. It is built for healthcare practices that operate on WhatsApp and messaging channels.

## Core Products

### 1. Clinical Sessions (Sesiones clínicas)
- Record doctor–patient visits
- Update the medical record / chart with structured notes
- Generate clinician summary + patient-friendly summary
- Share summaries on the connected channel (WhatsApp-first in LATAM)
- Available at: /es/producto/sesiones and /en/product/sessions

### 2. AI Receptionist (Recepcionista IA)
- 24/7 booking, confirmations, FAQs, and visit prep
- Smart escalation to human staff with full context
- Omnichannel inbox for clinic ops
- Available at: /es/producto/recepcionista and /en/product/receptionist
- Legacy URL redirects: /es/producto/agentes-ia → recepcionista

### 3. Appointments Engine (Motor de Citas)
- Native scheduling, no Calendly required
- Reminders, rescheduling, waitlist fill
- Multi-provider / multi-location support
- Available at: /es/producto/citas and /en/product/appointments

### 4. Omnichannel (Omnicanal)
- WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger in one clinical inbox
- Available at: /es/producto/omnicanal and /en/product/omnichannel

### 5. Shadia Agent
- Clinic team copilot via natural language (@shadia)
- Available at: /es/producto/agente and /en/product/agent

## Specialties

- General clinics: /es/especialidades/clinicas · /en/specialties/clinics
- Dental: /es/especialidades/odontologia · /en/specialties/dental
- Mental health: /es/especialidades/salud-mental · /en/specialties/mental-health
- Medical aesthetics: /es/especialidades/estetica · /en/specialties/aesthetics
- Hospitals & networks: /es/especialidades/hospitales · /en/specialties/hospitals

Legacy industry URLs redirect to specialties.

## Audience

Clinics and medical practices. Spanish experience is tuned for Dominican Republic and Latin America; English is global.

## Pricing

Three plans (USD): HOB (solo / small practices), PRO (growing clinics), ULTRA (networks).
See /es/precios and /en/pricing.

## Comparisons

- vs Calendly, conversational clinic scheduling vs booking links
- vs Confirmafy, full clinic ops vs reminder-only tools
- vs Heidi, sessions + receptionist + appointments vs scribe-only
- vs traditional front desk. AI layer vs people-and-spreadsheets only

Hub: /es/comparar · /en/compare
